```{=latex}
\begin{center}

\pgfdeclarelayer{highlight}
\pgfdeclarelayer{annotation}
\pgfsetlayers{main,highlight,annotation}

\begin{tikzpicture}[
>=Stealth,
font=\sffamily,
cell/.style={
  draw=gray!40,
  fill=gray!10,
  minimum width=2.2cm,
  minimum height=0.95cm,
  anchor=center
},
header/.style={
  cell,
  fill=green!65!black,
  draw=white,
  text=white,
  font=\bfseries
},
boxgreen/.style={
  fill=green!65!black,
  text=white,
  font=\bfseries\large,
  rounded corners=2pt,
  inner sep=4pt
},
boxorange/.style={
  fill=orange!85!black,
  text=white,
  font=\bfseries\large,
  rounded corners=2pt,
  inner sep=4pt
}
]

\matrix (M) [
matrix of nodes,
nodes={cell},
column sep=-\pgflinewidth,
row sep=-\pgflinewidth
]{
|[header]| mother & |[header]| father & |[header]| sex & |[header]| height \\
65.0 & 65 & F & 59.0\\
67.0 & 73 & M & 67.0\\
68.5 & 69 & M & 70.0\\
69.0 & 70 & M & 68.7\\
63.0 & 70 & F & 62.0\\
};

\begin{pgfonlayer}{highlight}
\node[
fill=orange,
opacity=.35,
rounded corners=8mm,
fit=(M-1-3)(M-6-3),
inner sep=4mm
]{};

\node[
fill=green!60,
opacity=.35,
rounded corners=8mm,
fit=(M-3-1)(M-3-4),
inner sep=3mm
]{};
\end{pgfonlayer}

\node[boxorange,above=12mm of M-1-3] (colbox) {Column};
\node[boxgreen,left=10mm of M-3-1] (rowbox) {Row};

\node[boxorange,below=18mm of M-6-2,xshift=1.1cm,minimum width=7cm] (varbox)
{4 Variables};

\node[boxgreen,right=20mm of M-4-4,minimum width=5cm] (specbox)
{5 Specimens};

\begin{pgfonlayer}{annotation}

\foreach \c/\dx in {1/-2.4,2/-0.8,3/0.8,4/2.4}{
\draw[orange!85!black,very thick,->]
($(varbox.north)+(\dx mm,0)$)
.. controls +(90:1.8) and +(-90:1.2) ..
(M-6-\c.south);
}

\foreach \r in {2,...,6}{
\draw[green!65!black,very thick,->]
(specbox.west)
.. controls +(-2,0) and +(1,0) ..
(M-\r-4.east);
}

\end{pgfonlayer}

\end{tikzpicture}

\end{center}
```
